description: Add auto-focus to admin PIN entry page so operators can immediately type the PIN without manually clicking the page first. The page already has a window-level keydown handler but doesn't set focus on mount. Add a hidden input with autoFocus to enable immediate keyboard input. This is independent of booth flow issues and can be done in any order.
steps: Add useRef hook for hidden input: const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
Add hidden <input> element before the PIN dots display: <input ref={inputRef} type="text" autoFocus style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '-9999px' }} aria-hidden="true" />
Add useEffect to focus on mount: useEffect(() => { inputRef.current?.focus() }, [])
Verify existing window keydown handler still works (it should — it's listening at window level)
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /admin/pin immediately accepts keyboard input without clicking
Typing digits 0-9 registers on the visual PIN display
Pressing Backspace removes the last digit
No visual changes to the page layout
verification: Run pnpm typecheck to verify TypeScript
WITHOUT clicking anywhere, immediately type 4 digits (e.g., 1234)
Verify digits appear in the PIN dots display
Press Backspace and verify last digit is removed
Press Enter and verify PIN submission attempt (will fail if wrong PIN, but proves keyboard is working)
